latest.author: skipperbent
latest.text: You can completely brick the app by screwing up the navigation bindings (which are hilariously awkward to configure) - for some reason they decided controller bindings also applies to the menu haha - good luck getting wii games configured. It does run games though (unless you bricked it like I did - then youll just be stuck at the menu with no directional buttons 😂). The app has a menu option for everything, by their attempt to satisfy everyone, they made it unnecessarily complicated.
